RedBound–Beyond Earth

We are a team of passionate innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project, *Beyond Earth – Martian Map*, focuses on developing an interactive, data-driven map of Mars using NASA's open scientific datasets.

Our goal is to combine Martian terrain, elevation data, geological information, and scientific observations into a unified platform that helps users explore the Martian surface and understand potential exploration routes for future astronauts.
